items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions picking up a clarinet for George Lewis; Interviewee responds by discussing the 'Albert system' and clarinet mechanics, not personal interaction.

ctx.x: many keys? Gee I don't remember I didn't I never know that much about the albert system because I was

playing Bain. A lot of them here now have 15 verses improved I picked one up for George Lewis about a month ago had about so close to 20 keys and rings on every finger. Yeah no he had this he had a simpler
kind of of albert system and it was the older the older albert system where the the tone holes
